bindings.label: The golden pyramid: drag across it for Drive; a sunburst grows out behind it, an eye opens on its face, and small flames rise on its slopes
The left stalk: drag up and down for the Upper 16' drawbar; it grows a new branch for every step, sap rising as it does
The right stalk: drag up and down for the Upper 5 1/3' drawbar; it grows a new branch for every step, sap rising as it does
The sleepy green creature is the rotor: tap its ear to cycle Stop, Slow, Fast; a whirlwind spins up round it, it wakes, and at Fast it raises its little arm
The worm swells with Expression: drag up and down; ripples spread, bands climb it, its crest blooms and its head flares into a trumpet
The stream leans while vibrato is on for the upper manual: tap to switch
The cloud fills with pencil scribbles as the wheels age: drag across it
The eye: tap to switch percussion; it blinks awake and its lid glows
The pink mushroom stem, top centre: the Upper 8' drawbar
The pink column between the stalks: the Upper 4' drawbar
The tall horned mask, top left: the Upper 2 2/3' drawbar
The magenta tree with one eye, left: the Upper 2' drawbar
The lavender creature with a straw, top right: the Upper 1 3/5' drawbar
The tall white cloud at the right edge: the Upper 1 1/3' drawbar
The party-hat cone by the big eye, right: the Upper 1' drawbar
The pink trunk with antlers, centre: the Lower 16' drawbar
The coral antler hand, bottom centre: the Lower 5 1/3' drawbar
The pink creature waving, lower left: the Lower 8' drawbar
The pink figure with a face, bottom centre: the Lower 4' drawbar
The blue-purple fish creature, right: the Lower 2 2/3' drawbar
The blue ghost with orange horns, top centre: the Lower 2' drawbar
The pink hill under the rocket, top right: the Lower 1 3/5' drawbar
The lavender mitten hand, bottom left: the Lower 1 1/3' drawbar
The pink collar of the horned creature, top left: the Lower 1' drawbar
The sandy ground: the Pedal 16' drawbar
The magenta cushion: the Pedal 8' drawbar
The orange sprite glows with Pedal Sustain
The big eyeball: tap for percussion Second or Third
The pink cap: tap for percussion decay Slow or Fast
The saucer: tap for percussion volume Normal or Soft (soft is paler)
The tunnel: tap through the six vibrato and chorus modes
The river bank leans while vibrato is on for the lower manual: tap
The tunnel rim lights while the rotating speaker is on: tap
The pink cloud: drag across for the horn/drum balance
The lavender snout swells with the microphone distance: drag across
The coral tongue leans with the microphone spread: drag across
The lying creature boils with Key Click: drag across
The fan hand boils with Release Click: drag across
The splash bush scribbles with tonewheel Leakage: drag across
The purple path scribbles with Crosstalk: drag across
The acorn frog: tap for complex or pure tonewheels
The striped shell: tap for gear or equal tuning
The left cliff turns in colour as the master tuning rises above 440 Hz (display only)
The sky brightens as the output Volume rises above -8 dB (display only)
The bunny slab shows the manual mode (display only: it changes which keys play which manual)
The purple ledge turns in colour as the split point rises above C4 (display only)
The grey ground shows the pedal split (display only)
